name: L-carnitine
description: Natural substance (levocarnitine) that moves long-chain fatty acids into mitochondria

note.text: Injection studies found were small or in dialysis patients, not healthy people seeking energy or fat loss.

bullets: **Label:** moves long-chain fatty acids into mitochondria, where they are burned
**Required** in mammalian energy metabolism, the Carnitor label says
**In dialysis,** effects on symptoms and outcomes “have not been determined” (label)
No study of compounded carnitine blends

practical.pharmacokinetics: Oral bioavailability about 15%; about 76% of IV dose in urine in 24 h
practical.soldAs: Prescription (Carnitor, generics); compounded blends not approved
practical.monitored: Plasma carnitine, blood chemistries, vital signs; INR on warfarin

regulatory.text: Not listed; IV over 100 mL per 12 h banned (M2.2)

references: Clin Nutr ESPEN, L-carnitine and body weight meta-analysis, Jun 2020
